finalText.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann den Aufbau der DNA aus Nukleotiden modellhaft darstellen und den Zusammenhang zwischen Basenfolge, komplementärer Basenpaarung und Speicherung genetischer Information erklären.
finalText.descriptionEn: The learner can model DNA structure from nucleotides and explain the relationship between base sequence, complementary base pairing and the storage of genetic information.

decisions.rationaleDe: Von Root delegierte technische Zusammenführung der tatsächlichen versiegelten A-/B-KEEP-Records über exakt denselben ganzen bilingualen Ziel-/Seiten-/Kontexteingang. Keine neue fachliche Bewertung, keine Quellen-Gesamtabdeckung, menschliche Freigabe oder strenger Nettozuwachs. A: Structure, base-complement and information storage coupled; replication is explicitly a separate existing target; matching A/T,G/C and opposite backbone directions in actual figure. Beide tatsächlichen nativen PDF-Kontexte betrachtet; vollständige DE/EN-Texte und begrenzte Originalquellen geprüft. Die sieben bestehenden Partnerziele bleiben erhalten und ganze ursprüngliche Quellenpflichten offen. B: KEEP: The whole DE/EN description now isolates DNA structure/information rather than also demanding replication. Both current cases exercise a labelled model and justified complementary correction with supplied rules. Original and native views depict a scientifically adequate schematic; broad heredity/carrier source duties remain partial.
decisions.rationaleEn: Root-delegated factual synthesis of actual sealed independent A/B KEEP records over the exact whole bilingual goal, native page and unchanged D context. No new scientific judgment, whole-source closure, human approval or strict gain. All four whole current native D inputs and actual selected images have sealed independent A/B judgments. Exact v2 paired P science remains separate. A: DNA consists of nucleotides containing sugar, phosphate and a base. Two complementary strands form the double-stranded model; the base sequence carries information. The A–T and G–C pairing rule constrains the relationship between the two strands, while different base sequences can store different information. A structural model alone does not explain replication. B: The base sequence stores information; complementary pairing connects two antiparallel nucleotide chains whose sugar-phosphate backbones carry the bases.

finalText.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann den Informationsfluss von einer gegebenen DNA-Sequenz über mRNA zu einem Polypeptid modellhaft darstellen und die Verbindung von Transkription und Translation erklären.
finalText.descriptionEn: The learner can model the information flow from a supplied DNA sequence via mRNA to a polypeptide and explain the connection between transcription and translation.

decisions.rationaleDe: Von Root delegierte technische Zusammenführung der tatsächlichen versiegelten A-/B-KEEP-Records über exakt denselben ganzen bilingualen Ziel-/Seiten-/Kontexteingang. Keine neue fachliche Bewertung, keine Quellen-Gesamtabdeckung, menschliche Freigabe oder strenger Nettozuwachs. A: Connected DNA-to-mRNA-to-polypeptide model with supplied sequence; transcription and translation are coupled steps, the eukaryotic image is a bounded example and bacterial transfer material is supplied. Beide tatsächlichen nativen PDF-Kontexte betrachtet; vollständige DE/EN-Texte und begrenzte Originalquellen geprüft. Die sieben bestehenden Partnerziele bleiben erhalten und ganze ursprüngliche Quellenpflichten offen. B: KEEP: The whole bilingual description is an assessable connected information-flow model. Current briefs identify strand direction/type, intron-free simplification and codon aids; fragment outputs are not misrepresented as complete functional proteins. Detailed pro/euk mechanism and reverse-code reconstruction remain separate existing goals/holds.
decisions.rationaleEn: Root-delegated factual synthesis of actual sealed independent A/B KEEP records over the exact whole bilingual goal, native page and unchanged D context. No new scientific judgment, whole-source closure, human approval or strict gain. All four whole current native D inputs and actual selected images have sealed independent A/B judgments. Exact v2 paired P science remains separate. A: Transcription produces RNA from a DNA template; translation uses the mRNA codon sequence, tRNA and a ribosome to assemble a polypeptide. The two stages must be connected and distinguished. The direction and type of the supplied DNA strand determine RNA derivation; the supplied code determines amino-acid order. In eukaryotes, nuclear transcription is spatially separate from translation outside the nucleus. B: Transcription transfers DNA information into mRNA; translation uses codons and tRNA at a ribosome to form a polypeptide. Both steps constitute a connected flow of information.

finalText.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Substitution, Deletion, Insertion und Duplikation an gegebenen DNA-Fällen unterscheiden und mögliche Folgen für das codierte Protein aus dem Genkontext begründen.
finalText.descriptionEn: The learner can distinguish substitution, deletion, insertion and duplication in given DNA cases and use the gene context to justify possible consequences for the encoded protein.

decisions.rationaleDe: Von Root delegierte technische Zusammenführung der tatsächlichen versiegelten A-/B-KEEP-Records über exakt denselben ganzen bilingualen Ziel-/Seiten-/Kontexteingang. Keine neue fachliche Bewertung, keine Quellen-Gesamtabdeckung, menschliche Freigabe oder strenger Nettozuwachs. A: Four sequence change mechanisms are assessed by change length and reading-frame/protein consequences; no universally harmful phenotype inference. Existing prerequisite475 supplies information-flow model. Beide tatsächlichen nativen PDF-Kontexte betrachtet; vollständige DE/EN-Texte und begrenzte Originalquellen geprüft. Die sieben bestehenden Partnerziele bleiben erhalten und ganze ursprüngliche Quellenpflichten offen. B: KEEP: The four change types and possible protein consequences form one integrated DNA-case analysis with gene context. Both current briefs state copy provenance for duplication and correctly separate modulo-three frame effects, synonymous changes and measured function. Mutation-level, mutagen-risk and phenotype duties remain separate.
decisions.rationaleEn: Root-delegated factual synthesis of actual sealed independent A/B KEEP records over the exact whole bilingual goal, native page and unchanged D context. No new scientific judgment, whole-source closure, human approval or strict gain. All four whole current native D inputs and actual selected images have sealed independent A/B judgments. Exact v2 paired P science remains separate. A: A substitution replaces a base without changing sequence length; a deletion removes bases and an insertion adds bases. A duplication copies an existing segment. An added matching sequence establishes duplication as its origin only when the change evidence supports that origin. A possible consequence of a change in a coding gene region depends on the reading frame, the genetic code and the length of the change. A substitution may encode the same amino acid or a different one; adding or removing a number of bases not divisible by three can shift the reading frame. Sequence alone establishes neither a certain change in protein function nor a trait. B: Sequence-change type, reading-frame effect and possible protein consequence are distinct levels requiring a connected explanation; duplication requires evidence of copied origin.

finalText.titleEn: Explain DNA Replication with a Simple Model
finalText.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann die Bedeutung der DNA-Replikation erklären und an einem einfachen Modell zeigen, dass bei semikonservativer Replikation jeder neue DNA-Doppelstrang einen ursprünglichen und einen neu gebildeten Einzelstrang enthält.
finalText.descriptionEn: The learner can explain the significance of DNA replication and use a simple model to show that, in semiconservative replication, each new DNA double strand contains one original and one newly formed single strand.

Both target IDs and requiredDNAstructural prerequisite preserved. Beide tatsächlichen nativen PDF-Kontexte betrachtet; vollständige DE/EN-Texte und begrenzte Originalquellen geprüft. decisions.rationaleEn: Root-delegated factual synthesis of actual sealed independent A/B KEEP records over the exact whole bilingual goal, native page and unchanged D context. No new scientific judgment, whole-source closure, human approval or strict gain. All four whole current native D inputs and actual selected images have sealed independent A/B judgments. Exact v2 paired P science remains separate. A: In semiconservative DNA replication, the separated existing strands serve as templates for complementary new strands. Each daughter DNA molecule contains one old and one new strand; the model preserves genetic information for subsequent cells. B: Each original DNA single strand templates a new complementary strand; each daughter DNA contains one old and one new strand and preserves the sequence information.
